luna_triage.omission_quote: The direct Narrow-Control test that we employed has been used in studies by Wilcox and her collaborators as well. For example, in their followup to the reference study, Wilcox and Baillargeon [5] obtained consistently shorter looking times in the narrow-screen ball-ball conditions (7.5-month-olds: 𝑀narrow-ball-ball = 18.5 s; SD = 11.0; 4.5-month-olds: 𝑀narrow-ball-ball = 22.9 s, SD = 9.2), relative to the narrow-screen ball-box conditions (7.5-month-olds: 𝑀narrow-ball-box = 34.2 s, SD = 8.6; 4.5-month-olds: 𝑀narrow-ball-box = 40.2 s, SD = 10.5; see also [23]).
